title: "Navdeep Rana"
---
I am a theoretical physicist and my research interests lie broadly in the field of soft condensed matter physics.
In particular, I am interested in the physics of active matter, turbulence, population dynamics of growing bacterial colonies, and high-performance computing.

Currently, I am working as a [DSTrain](https://www.uio.no/dscience/english/dstrain/) postdoctoral fellow at the [Department of Physics](https://www.mn.uio.no/fysikk/english/), University of Oslo.

Here is my [CV](cv.qmd) and here are my [research interests](research.qmd).
